subject: ByteCloud performance preflight: k6 scenarios, allowlist & test window
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bytecloud.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & asks — performance targets / test logistics

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call just now. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can get the customer-led run scheduled: 

Summary of targets we discussed:
- Latency: p95 end-to-end generation <= 120 ms for payloads ~256 tokens (non-streaming)
- Throughput: sustained 350–450 req/s for peak test windows
- Streaming: support ~75 concurrent streaming connections (low per-connection token rate) with tail latency p95 <= 200 ms
- Error budget: <0.5% 5xx during test window

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Confirm an IP allowlist (CIDR or static IPs) we should open for the test traffic.
2) Provide preferred 2-hour test windows next week (we proposed Tue/Wed 09:00–11:00 PT as options).
3) Confirm whether your team will run k6 or Locust (you mentioned k6) and whether you need the sample scenarios we attached.
4) Provide a test account (or confirm we should mint a short-lived API key) and a contact for firewall/network handoff.

Attachments: redwood-bytecloud-k6-scenarios.json (sample k6 scenarios adapted to our runtime).

Next steps: if you confirm window and allowlist today we’ll create a dedicated test account and share credentials via a secure transfer. Marissa will lead the key exchange and Neha will own observability hooks.

Thanks —
Rafael
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bytecloud.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris O'Neal <chris.oneal@bytecloud.ai>, Lauren Mills <lauren.mills@bytecloud.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & asks — performance targets / test logistics

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear recap. All good on the targets; confirming the specifics below and a few notes from infra/QA: 

Confirmed test window: Tue, May 18, 2027 09:00–11:00 PT (our QA lead prefers mornings).
IP allowlist for test traffic: 198.51.100.0/28 and 203.0.113.5 (static egress we can use).
We will run k6 (team uses JS scenarios). We reviewed your attached scenarios and they look close to what we need — we’ll add a small streaming hook to mirror our client behaviour.
Test account: please provide a short-lived key for a dedicated test account. Our QA can't use production keys.
Firewall contact: Chris O'Neal (chris.oneal@bytecloud.ai) — he’ll coordinate with our networking team.

Couple of asks from our side:
- Can you provide a lightweight script or guidance for streaming concurrency so we match your recommended connection behaviour?
- We’d like a 10–15 minute smoke run 24 hours before the main window to validate allowlist and creds.

We’ll attach any local k6 tuning we do and share our results. Looking forward to the run.

—Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Ops, ByteCloud

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap — action items (internal)

Team — forwarding Sam's confirmation. Need quick internal alignment so we don’t miss the window. Action owners below: 

Action items (owners):
- Create dedicated test account + short-lived API key (Marissa) — scope: isolated project, revoke after 48h.
- Generate k6 streaming guidance & sample hook (Neha) — include recommended arrival rates and connection lifecycle for ~75 concurrent streams.
- Coordinate IP allowlist add with infra + confirm NAT/egress mapping (Dylan) — ByteCloud provided 198.51.100.0/28 and 203.0.113.5.
- Setup lightweight observability dashboard for the run (Neha) — token-level latency, errors, GPU utilization, and request traces.
- Schedule 15-minute smoke test on May 17 09:00 PT (24h prior) and full run on May 18 09:00–11:00 PT.

Please reply in thread with ETA for each item — Marissa, can you create the creds and provide the secure link to hand them off to Sam? Neha — target to drop the streaming snippet by EOD Friday. Dylan — confirm infra contact and whether we need a CIDR exception on our side.

Thanks —
Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap — action items (internal)

Rafael —

Done: I created a test project and minted a short-lived key (valid 48h). I uploaded the credential file to our secure share and pasted a one-time-access link below for handoff to ByteCloud. I also added a note in the project that traffic should be scoped to the test API only.

Credentials link (one-time): https://secrets.redwood.ai/one-time/bytecloud-4821-creds
Attachment: bytecloud-test-account-instructions.pdf (shows how to swap the key and scope).

ETA: creds are ready now. I will wait for Rafael to confirm before we hand them to Samantha.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bytecloud.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Chris O'Neal <chris.oneal@bytecloud.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: ByteCloud test window + creds handoff

Sam —

We're set for today 09:00–11:00 PT. Per our internal checklist: 
- One-time creds link sent to Marissa; Marissa will share the secure link with your Chris O'Neal directly (per your firewall contact) rather than pasting creds in email.
- Neha attached the streaming guidance and a short snippet to emulate your client connection lifecycle (see preflight-checklist.md).
- Dylan will validate NAT mappings; please confirm once your infra team has whitelisted 198.51.100.0/28 and 203.0.113.5.
- Please run a 10–15 minute smoke test now if possible; otherwise we’ll do the smoke run 24 hours before next time.

Attachments: preflight-checklist.md, bytecloud-temp-creds.txt (note: creds are delivered via secure one-time link — file here is a stub).

Thanks everyone — we’ll monitor the dashboard and stand by to adjust arrival rates during the window.

Rafael
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
